units.source_text: 入社前几日举行祓禊[\[4\]](#part1338.html#m4)，执事的公卿人数本有一定。

en.t: A few days before the imperial consort's formal entry, the purification rite was held; the number of court nobles who would serve at the ceremony was normally fixed.

units.source_text: 但此次选得特别讲究，都是声望高贵、容貌优秀的人。

en.t: But this time the selection was made with unusual care, and all of them were men of high reputation, noble rank, and handsome appearance.

units.source_text: 连他们的衬衣的色彩、外裙的纹样，以至马和鞍镫，也都选得齐齐整整。

en.t: Even the colors of their under-robes, the patterns of their outer skirts, and even the horses, saddles, and stirrups were chosen in perfect order.

units.source_text: 又下特旨，令源氏大将参与行事。

en.t: A special imperial order was also issued, directing General Genji to take part in the ceremony.

units.source_text: 女眷所乘游览车，都预先准备，装饰得辉煌灿烂。

en.t: The sightseeing carriages for the ladies had all been prepared in advance and were decorated with dazzling splendor.

units.source_text: 祓禊行列将要通过的一条大路上，车水马龙，冠盖相望，拥挤得几无隙地。

en.t: Along the broad avenue where the purification procession was to pass, carriages and horses streamed together, canopies and court caps stretched as far as the eye could see, and the crowd left almost no empty space.

units.source_text: 各处临时搭起来的看台，装饰得各尽其美。

en.t: The temporary viewing stands set up here and there were each decorated as beautifully as possible.

units.source_text: 女人们的衣袖衫裾露出在帘下，鲜艳夺目，真乃良辰美景！

en.t: The women's sleeves and hems showed beneath the blinds, bright and striking to the eye; it was truly a splendid day and a beautiful scene.
